notes: Firepower cabinet flipper-button path. System 6 has no flipper matrix column of its own: the driver declares FLIP_SWNO(0,45), so core_updateSw copies the right cabinet button (synthetic flipper-column position 82) into matrix switch 45 every frame, and PinMAME publishes the synthetic flipper coil states 45-48 only while the game-on enable (23) is set. This run never writes public 45: after a started game lights lamp 5 from the F rollover (32), it presses 82 and then 84 and records whether the ROM moves the lit lane-change lamp and which synthetic flipper outputs follow each button. Run from an NVRAM initialized by one prior empty-NVRAM power-up.
